title: Charcoal Briquettes 8kg

drivers.name: Promotion: 15% off
drivers.evidence: Past 30% off (2026-04-06) lifted sales x2.53; 15% off is shallower but still strong. Seasonal ramp (Memorial Day: x2.0) and recent trend support uplift. Noise-adjusted past promotion lift is x1.0, but one outlier (x2.53) justifies upward adjustment.

adjustment.analysis: The 30% off promotion in 2026-04-06 drove sales to x2.53 vs baseline, the strongest past lift. The noise-adjusted estimate for all past promotions is x1.0, but the 30% off event was exceptional and not typical. This week’s 15% off is shallower, but the product is on a seasonal ramp (Memorial Day: x2.0), and the baseline is rising. The prior week (2026-05-25) saw x2.0, suggesting momentum. The classical model’s x1.0 is too low; adjust upward for the deep discount and event timing. Shrink toward 1.0 due to limited past 15% off data and noise.
